name: Antran
source:
Antran (full name is Antran Ilmerid) – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change and a Nental class mentor.
An adult green orange-eyed om'verai with an always calm facial expression. An'tran wears V-like eye masks. An'tran has a mohawk-like back head spikes of dark-green color, as well as wing membranes of same color. An'tran has light belly plates and dark-green front paw ones.
Antran is a calm mysterious sneaky om'verai. Teaches Azaries to not kill if unndecessary despite of being know as an assassin. An'tran values valor and honesty, as well as those who protects weaker ones.
Antran is the only class mentor whose last name was revealed.
